h2: Plumber Bali: One Person Who Finds the Real Problem
intro: When a tap drips at 6 am or your hot water suddenly stops, you don't want a call centre — you want one plumber Bali villa owners can actually reach. I come myself, trace the cause through pipes, pumps and mixers, and fix it on the spot across Canggu, Ubud, Seminyak, Uluwatu, Sanur, Jimbaran, Kuta & Legian, Nusa Dua, Denpasar, Kerobokan and Umalas.

sections.h3: Why Bali Villas Leak More Than You'd Think
sections.text: Tropical heat expands PVC joints, salt air corrodes brass fittings near Uluwatu or Jimbaran, and borehole water carries minerals that build up inside cisterns and mixers. The result is familiar: a slow drip from a basin tap, a toilet that never fully stops running, or hot water that takes five minutes to arrive. None of these are 'just Bali' — they're fixable, but the cause usually sits somewhere upstream of where the symptom shows.

sections.h3: What I Actually Do When I Arrive
sections.text: I start by isolating the supply and checking pressure at the source, then work through mixers, traps, hoses, cistern mechanisms and pump wiring until I've found what's actually failing. From there it's straightforward: replace a worn washer, swap a corroded hose, re-seat a flapper valve, or hook up your washing machine and dishwasher properly so nothing leaks behind the cabinet. One person handles diagnosis and repair in the same visit.

sections.h3: Send Me Photos Before I Drive Over
sections.text: Before I head out, send a short WhatsApp message with two or three photos of the problem area — under the sink, inside the cistern lid, or wherever water is pooling. Tell me which villa or apartment it is and roughly where you sit on the island (Canggu, Seminyak, Sanur, etc.). If pressure has dropped across the whole unit, mention that too. With those details I can bring the right parts and skip guesswork, so the job wraps up faster once I'm at your door.

sections.h3: Small Habits That Save a Villa From Big Repairs
sections.text: Once a month, lift the cistern lid and check for mineral crust on the flapper; wipe out the drain under each basin tap while it's still clean; give pump connections a quick look for weeping. In coastal stretches like Uluwatu or Jimbaran, rinse exposed brass fittings with fresh water after heavy rain to slow salt buildup. These two-minute checks catch small failures before they become a flooded bathroom at 2 am.

faq.q: Do you cover my area in Bali?
faq.a: Yes — I work across Canggu, Ubud, Seminyak, Uluwatu, Sanur, Jimbaran, Kuta & Legian, Nusa Dua, Denpasar, Kerobokan and Umalas. Drop your location on WhatsApp and I'll confirm the visit.

faq.q: How do I get a quote?
faq.a: Send photos of the issue plus a short description via WhatsApp. The cost depends on what's actually wrong, so I'll give you a fair number once I've seen it or diagnosed it on site.

faq.q: Can you handle both plumbing and pool equipment?
faq.a: I do both under one roof — taps, toilets, pumps, hot-water systems as well as pool filters and circulation gear. One message covers everything, no need to juggle two contractors.
